title: Report
description: The schema-capped return of a working agent. Transport, not truth: full artifacts persist in the war archive and are reached through `artifacts`. Mirrors src/contracts/report.ts — test/contracts.test.ts fails if the two drift. NO `$schema` KEY: claude --json-schema cannot resolve the 2020-12 meta-schema URI and rejects the file outright. STRICT MODE: every property appears in `required` at every level and every optional property is nullable, because codex --output-schema uses OpenAI strict structured outputs, which rejects any property missing from `required`. Both rules are asserted by test/contracts.test.ts.

status.description: done = the orders were carried out; blocked = stopped on something outside this agent's authority, in which case put the decision you need into `question`; failed = attempted and could not.

summary.description: One line. What happened, for a commander who will read nothing else.

findings.description: At most five. More than five is a report.md, not a return value.

artifacts.description: Pointers to the big stuff: report.md, diff.patch, stream.jsonl, the branch, the PR.

branch.description: The army/<task-id> branch this agent cut. null if it cut none.

costUsd.description: Cost of this attempt, as reported by the harness. null if unknown.

question.description: The decision you could not make. Fill this in whenever status is blocked: a block WITH a question climbs to a human, and the answer comes back to a fresh attempt in this same worktree, briefed with it. A block with none simply ends your attempt, and your summary and findings are all anyone gets. One line, no newlines. State the decision and the options you see, not a description of how you got stuck. null on done and failed.

file.description: Repo-relative where possible, so it survives the worktree being returned. null when the finding is not about a file.

line.description: 1-based. null when the finding is not about a line.

ref.description: A path, branch name, PR reference or url, depending on kind.

note.description: One-line gloss. null when there is nothing to add.
